capabilities: Sync books, authors, quotes, journal entries, insights, and domain mastery from ReadingRate as Markdown notes
Insert quotes anywhere while writing via fuzzy-search commands
Generate Bases and Dataview dashboards for the synced library
Build a reading Canvas grouping books by genre
Link journal entries and insights to daily notes and color-code graph view
extras: Account required (free tier covers all sync features; a paid subscription adds AI synthesis sections and a monthly wiki page). The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Sync is one-directional (ReadingRate → vault) over HTTPS to a Supabase-hosted API; no vault data is uploaded.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull a user's reading data from the ReadingRate service into linked, searchable vault notes.

relations.evidence: Dataview pages — for vaults that already use the Dataview plugin.
Via BRAT: add simonsbookclub/readingrate-obsidian in BRAT and it will install and update automatically.

summary: Syncs ReadingRate reading data — books, authors, quotes, journal entries, insights — into the vault as interconnected Markdown notes with frontmatter and wikilinks.
